items.title: Market scanner fires expensive sequential MCP scans without checking TradingView MCP runtime readiness first
items.summary:
## Problem

`POST /api/webhook/market-scanner-alert` launches sequential `runScans()` calls immediately after request validation, without checking the TradingView MCP runtime readiness status. When the MCP endpoint is down, suspended (see #630), or degraded, every scan attempt wastes the per-call timeout budget (`TRADINGVIEW_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS`, default 12s) multiplied by the number of scans before finally returning 502/504.
